sections.text: Transmission Lines
Technical Procedure
Introduction

The
 purpose of this procedure is to provide detailed instructions on a safe method
 for replacing insulators on 500KV Suspension Russian towers type P.
Safety Precautions

items:
An
 authorized work permit must be issued

Use
 approved fall arrest procedures

Use
 approved temporary earthing procedures

Use
 personal protective equipment (flash glasses, safety helmet, safety boots
 and glovesetc).

Line
 workers uniforms must be colored to indicate the disconnected circuit that
 they will be working on.

All
 equipment must be rated for the loads that they will carry and be checked
 and approved prior to the beginning of the work.

Communication
 between the control unit, the supervisor and the crew members must be
 ensured.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

Complete set of earthing equipment
(i.e. Clamp stick, earthing cables, 150 mm
2 or 2 x 75 mm 2, Potential indicator, Steel brush, Insulating gloves up to 20
kv).
Work to be Carried Out
The circuit must be disconnected according to EEC rules.

Line
 workers must climb the 2 towers on either of side of the tower to be worked
 on and apply temporary earths according to approved earthing procedures
 after verifying isolation of the circuit by using a potential tester.

Two
 line workers may then climb the tower to the cross-arm above the conductor
 and install the hand-line in an appropriate position.

Raise
 and install the rope ladder.

Raise and install the wire rope slings, shackles and 6 ton chain hoists and 
suspension clamps as shown if (Figure # 1).

Raise
 and install the wire rope safety sling as shown in (Figure # 1).

Take
 up tension on the two 6 ton chain hoists to slacken the insulator strings.

Disconnect
 the insulator string from the conductor clamp so it is left suspended from
 the tower arm by the L joint and 6 ton shackle only.

Using
 the hand-line, install the winch cable in the leg snatch block and the
 cross-arm snatch block and attach the winch cable to the L joint with
 a shackle.

Raise
 the insulator string gradually using the winch cable until the shackle
 attaching it to the cross-arm becomes slack.

Release
 the pin of the shackle connecting the L joint to the cross-arm.

Attach
 the 40 meter hand-line to the insulator string to control the strings
 movement and prevent it from hitting the tower steel as it is being lowered
 to the ground.

Lower
 the insulator string slowly to the ground on the winch cable.

Assemble
 the new insulator string on the ground and check all cotter keys.

Attach
 the new insulator string to the winch cable and raise it to the suspension
 point on the cross-arm.

Connect
 the new insulator string to the cross-arm and release the winch cable.

Connect
 the new insulator string to the conductor clamp and release the two 6 ton
 hoists.

Disconnect
 the chain hoist assemblies and safety sling from the cross-arm and lower to
 the ground on the hand-line.

Lower
 the winch cable and snatch blocks to the ground.

Remove
 the temporary earths after the circuit is cleared of all men and equipment.

Close
 the work permit according to EEC Electrical Safety Rules.
